paragraphs.text: Runadi , Behemoth Caller , is a Nacatl Shaman from Alara that was introduced in Jumpstart 2022 .

Runadi made his debut as part of the Green Gigantic deck in Jumpstart 2022 . He is a Nacatl godtracker shaman from Naya who is known to call large behemoths to his aid. Godtrackers carefully monitor the movements of the gargantuans of Naya and offer sacrifices to keep them appeased. He wears a green robe, wields a spear, and uses incense.
